about_the_game:
HR called, you're FIRED!

Suck It Up! is a twin-stick shooter game about sticking it to the man and hurling insults back at your loud coworkers. Explore a series of office floors while completing tasks and eliminating a plethora of working-class enemies. 

Who're they hiring?

The office floor has a series of employees, each with different and unique attacks. Some projectiles bounce, some cause explosions, and some will lock in on your location. 

Sink or Suck

The name of the game is sucking, and that's what you must do. Suck up enemy projectiles with the megaphone to gain different attacks and different ways of clearing the office floor! Low on health? Suck up water at one of the coolers around the map to gain a little boost! 

The Boss

Beat the other office floors to gain entrance to the Boss's office, where you must confront the very person who fired you! Beat different stages of combat to gain the upper hand and cement your place at the very TOP of the corporate ladder.

short_description: The corporate world WILL burst your bubble... so you must fight back! Use your coworkers' words against them and take your issues up the corporate ladder to your boss in this retro twin-stick shooter game. Choose your words carefully... one wrong move and you will be TERMINATED.
